game.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
game.rules:
**General Rules:**

- Game version must be the latest available (currently Ver. 1.5.0 for Wii U and Ver. 1.6.0 for Switch)
- ***Emulators are Banned.***
- All homebrew applications are banned, except for BotwRuns v1.0 found in the resources section.
- Any glitch that persists throughout save files or new game must be removed before the run.
- Note: When submitting runs, please do not include milliseconds in your time. That slot exists for the Individual Levels.

**amiibo Rules**

- Having the amiibo rune active is allowed in no amiibo runs.

**Video Submission Guidelines**

- Video proof is required for every run.
- Recordings must show proof of the game launching from the home menu to confirm a fresh start.
- Runners must not manipulate load times before the run starts, for example by loading a file or starting a new game beforehand.
- The version number in the bottom right corner must be shown.
- Low quality recordings (such as camera recordings) are allowed as long as the gameplay is recognizable.
- Game audio is not necessarily required (with the exception of top 10 runs), but highly encouraged.
- Only the following video sharing services are allowed:
- Youtube: Video must be public/unlisted; Recommended to upload runs since it's easier for verifiers to check the run.
- Twitch: Past Broadcasts are not allowed, they are removed automatically from Twitch after a certain period of time; Video must be viewable to everyone (not subscribers only).
- bilibili: Allowed to make sure people in certain regions of the world are able to submit.
- Twitter: Be aware of the duration limit of 2 minutes and 20 seconds.
Allowed for people who are only able to upload directly from their Nintendo Switch.

categories.name: Bug Limit Categories
categories.rules:
**Bug Limit Definition:**
 
Allowed tricks:
* Whistle Sprinting
* Shield Jumping to gain distance or height
* Infinite Horse Stamina
* Cryonis Jump
* Cancelling attack animations
* Cancelling fall damage by swapping equipment
* Abusing stasis to gain distance or momentum without taking knockback from the object (e.g. Rocket Launch, Box Jump, Box Walking)
* Abusing Ragdoll physics to skip puzzles (e.g. Ragdoll Boost, Ragdoll Jump, avoiding knockback with Ragdoll Glitch)
* Removing burn damage temporarily with a spin attack, also known as Burn Timer Reset
* Stunlocking Calamity
 
Banned tricks:
* Using stasis on an object to knockback Link for the purpose of gaining horizontal or vertical momentum, Bomb Boosting, or any other form of Damage Boosting
* Abusing bullet time to modify Link's speed value
* Damaging a boss mid cutscene (eg. Windblight and Calamity Skip)
* Clipping through solid objects or collision
* Resetting stasis cooldown to chain multiple stasis tricks mid-air, also known as Stasis Reset
* Gravity Launch
* Stasis Bounce
* Flying Machine
* Weapon Smuggling
* Apparatus Glitch
* Skew Glitch
* Moon Jump
* Shrine Coordinate Warp
* Camera Displacement
* Minigame Storage
* Menu Overload
* Dynamic Object Glitch
* Obtain compendium pictures by selling items in Hateno
* Wall Jumps
* Bow Spinning
* Daruk's Perfect Parry
* Golden Gauntlets
* Shield Block Reset
 
Note: There are many glitches and tricks in BotW and not everything is included. If a trick is not mentioned here, you may ask first if it's allowed or not before using it in a run.
 
**Category Specific Rules:**
* Refer to the respective category for rules, objectives and DLC usage.

categories.name: Best Ending
categories.rules:
**Best Ending Rules**
* Runs must start from New Game.
* Timing starts when gaining control of Link.
* Must gather all 13 Memories and be able to watch the special ending.
* Timing ends when the last arrow makes contact with Dark Beast Ganon (first frame of the explosion animation).

**DLC Rules**

Original DLC disallows the usage of Chamption's Ballad DLC items/bonuses. 

If you have DLC installed, you can use the following conditions to start your timer early, to counteract DLC cutscenes:

-  –45 seconds for the Master Trials cutscene.
Condition 1: Must not be in Master Mode.
Condition 2: Cannot use any chests or bonuses from the Master Trials

- –52 seconds for the Champions' Ballad cutscene.

- Game version must be the latest available (currently Ver. 1.5.0 for Wii U and Ver. 1.6.0 for Switch)
- All homebrew applications are banned, except for BotwRuns v1.0 found in the resources section.
- Video proof is required.
- Video must contain an additional second of cutscene after run is complete.
- Any preparation is allowed (unless specified). This includes, but is not limited to, entering with:
Attack, Defense, or Speed boosts, Bonus Hearts, Bonus Stamina, “Moonjump”, “Skew”.

**Divine Beast Any% Rules**

- Timing starts when gaining control of Link.
- Timing ends once you interact with the final pedestal of the Divine Beast.
- The Divine Beast must be completely untouched before starting.

**No Major Glitches Rules**

- Same as Any%
- The following tricks are not allowed to be performed during the run or setup during the preparation in order to do during the run:
- Clipping through solid surfaces or objects.
- Moonjump
- Windbomb
- Horse Sliding
- Skew Bouncing
- Bomb Bouncing
- Bow Lift Smuggling
- Amplifying momentum by abusing bullet time slowdown
- Void Out Storage or any other effect of Apparatus Storage
- (Note: Newly discovered glitches/tricks will be subject to a vote before being allowed or banned).

**100% Rules**

- Same as Any%
- Must open all 8 chests and obtain the item within. Destroying wooden chests is allowed as long as the item is collected. List of chests:
- Giant Ancient Core
- Ice Arrow x10
- Knight’s Bow
- Ancient Shaft
- Bomb Arrow x5
- Ancient Core
- Knight’s Claymore
- Sapphire
- Must obtain the Heart Container.
- Must defeat all enemies.

**No Major Glitches 100% Rules**

- Same as Any%
- Same as No Major Glitches Rules
- Same as 100%

**Bug Limit Definition:**
 
Allowed tricks:
* Whistle Sprinting
* Shield Jumping to gain distance or height
* Infinite Horse Stamina
* Cryonis Jump
* Cancelling attack animations
* Cancelling fall damage by swapping equipment
* Abusing stasis to gain distance or momentum without taking knockback from the object (e.g. Rocket Launch, Box Jump, Box Walking)
* Abusing Ragdoll physics to skip puzzles (e.g. Ragdoll Boost, Ragdoll Jump, avoiding knockback with Ragdoll Glitch)
* Removing burn damage temporarily with a spin attack, also known as Burn Timer Reset
* Stunlocking Calamity
 
Banned tricks:
* Using stasis on an object to knockback Link for the purpose of gaining horizontal or vertical momentum, Bomb Boosting, or any other form of Damage Boosting
* Abusing bullet time to modify Link's speed value
* Damaging a boss mid cutscene (eg. Windblight and Calamity Skip)
* Clipping through solid objects or collision
* Resetting stasis cooldown to chain multiple stasis tricks mid-air, also known as Stasis Reset
* Gravity Launch
* Stasis Bounce
* Flying Machine
* Weapon Smuggling
* Apparatus Glitch
* Skew Glitch
* Moon Jump
* Shrine Coordinate Warp
* Camera Displacement
* Minigame Storage
* Menu Overload
* Dynamic Object Glitch
* Obtain compendium pictures by selling items in Hateno
* Wall Jumps
* Bow Spinning
* Daruk's Perfect Parry
* Golden Gauntlets
* Shield Block Reset
 
Note: There are many glitches and tricks in BotW and not everything is included. If a trick is not mentioned here, you may ask first if it's allowed or not before using it in a run.
